'''Gartogg''' was a [[Gamorrean]] who served the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] as a guard in his [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. The guard—who was thuggish in nature and not particularly [[Sentience|intelligent]]—was present in the palace when the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker]] visited Jabba in order to try and [[Rescue of Han Solo|rescue]] the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]].<ref name="AEYNTK">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''</ref>
